label: EXPLORATORY (docs/RAG_V2_CRITERIA.md section 8)
prompt:
/no_think
You help a search engine connect EU law with business processes.

Below is one passage of EU law. Write 1 or 2 short sentences in plain business language that say when this passage
applies in a business process: which kind of business, which step or situation (for example taking an order, sending
an invoice, paying a supplier, delivering goods, handling a return, collecting customer data), and who is involved.

Rules:
- Use everyday business words, not legal terms. Do not name directives, articles or numbers.
- Say only what the passage supports. Do not add obligations that are not in the passage.
- Write only the 1 or 2 sentences. No list, no heading, no other text.

Passage:
General Data Protection Regulation (2016/679) - Article 21: Right to object
4. At the latest at the time of the first communication with the data subject, the right referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 shall be explicitly brought to the attention of the data subject and shall be presented clearly and separately from any other information.
raw_output: When a business sends customer data for the first time, they must clearly explain the right to object to data processing, separate from other information, to the customer. This applies when handling customer data during data collection or communication.
enrichment: When a business sends customer data for the first time, they must clearly explain the right to object to data processing, separate from other information, to the customer. This applies when handling customer data during data collection or communication.
